intent_en: To illustrate the dramatic surge in daily oxygen demand in India during the 2021 pandemic wave.
previous_intent: To illustrate the dramatic surge in estimated daily oxygen demand in India during the second wave of the pandemic in early 2021, highlighting the critical shortage where supply could not match the increased need.
narration_support: And when these cases went up, so did the demand for life -saving oxygen. But India hasn't been able to match that demand.
chart_support: Line chart showing estimated daily oxygen needed from March 2020 to April 2021, displaying a massive spike in demand in early 2021.
evidence_note: The narration links rising cases to rising oxygen demand and a supply mismatch, while the chart visualizes the corresponding sharp increase in oxygen demand, particularly the spike in early 2021.
